title: A small text change on an existing screen skips the designer
why: Owner ask ask-mw18vywh8g, Nov 3 16:13 CST: 'small text changes on existing screens currently can't skip a designer agent -- this is clearly a scenario where the guards are making unintentional outcomes from what i desire'.
note:
Nov 6 12:01 CST (coordinator replan: Opus plan and critic, main 7975f6d8, roadmap 01995020): DONE, evidence on main (coordinator's replan check).
Cause, read on main da8d8073: CLAUDE.md rule roles-one-role-per-agent says 'A lane that touches a screen gets a designer before the builder and a design reviewer after it', with no exception. No claude-settings hook enforces it (grep hooks/ and lint/); a child-repo guard may, which lane child-guard-promotion surveys. Change: the rule exempts a lane that changes only text on an existing screen (no layout, component or style change) from the designer; the design reviewer still checks the built screen. Any child guard that enforces the old text follows. The owner's ask is the direction; the lane brings the exact rule wording to the coordinator before merge. Port: yes, every repo. Lane session_013NEJL3ZRxUhkAUzwDpf66L, started by the coordinator Nov 3.
